response.sql:
SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
GROUP BY original_language_id
ORDER BY film_count DESC, original_language_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Films with a NULL original_language_id form one group, as in standard SQL GROUP BY behavior; missing values in the averaged expression are ignored by AVG.
